primary.title: Multibagger Signature Global shares to be in focus on Wednesday after Q1 pre-sales rise 25% QoQ
primary.summary: Signature Global's Q1 FY27 results show pre-sales at ₹1,970 crore, down 25% YoY but up 25% QoQ, driven by the Tonino Lamborghini Residences launch.
